*Unless otherwise stated, all dollar amounts in this news release are expressed in Canadian dollars.*


**VANCOUVER, Canada – October 15, 2026** – New Found Gold Corp. (TSX and NYSE-A: NFGC) (“ **New Found Gold** ” or the “ **Company** “) is pleased to report its operational results for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026 following the achievement of commercial production at the Company’s 100% owned Hammerdown Gold Mine (“ **Hammerdown** ” or the “ **Mine** ”) on August 19, 20261.


**Preliminary Third Quarter 2026 Production Highlights:**


- **Gold production** : 4,863 ounces
- **Gold sold** : 6,035 ounces
- **Average Realized Gold Price:** US$4,310 ($6,033)
- **Average Gold Recovery:** 85%


“ *Today we have reached another milestone for New Found Gold, announcing the first quarterly operational results from Canada’s newest gold producer. In the third quarter of 2026, Hammerdown recorded gold production of 4,863 ounces, reflecting strong operational performance through the final stages of our ramp up into the first full month of commercial production. Building on the performance delivered to date, we anticipate a strong finish to the year at Hammerdown and to carry that momentum into 2027,* ” stated Keith Boyle, CEO of New Found Gold. “ *Hammerdown and the Pine Cove Mill are performing well, exceeding several key production targets and resulting in steady-state production.*


“ *More importantly for investors, in under a year, New Found Gold has built a successful operations team in central Newfoundland. We will now use the knowledge and experience gained from bringing Hammerdown into production and focus on advancing our fully funded flagship Queensway Gold Project to production.”*

**Operational Review**


As previously announced, the Company’s 100% owned Hammerdown Gold Mine (“ **Hammerdown** ”) achieved commercial production on August 19, 2026.


The third quarter of 2026 delivered strong operational performance, with Hammerdown and the Pine Cove Mill (“ **Pine Cove** ” or the “ **Mill** ”) meeting or exceeding key production targets as mining reached steady-state production.


Based on work completed year-to-date, the operations are positioned for a strong Q4/26.


**Financial Position**


The Company has a strong financial position as at September 30, 2026, with:


- Cash and cash equivalents of approximately $167 million ($194 million as at June 30, 2026), and
- Debt of $70 million ($70 million as at June 30, 2026); with a further $35 million debt facility available until May 15, 2027, subject to the satisfaction of certain conditions precedent (see New Found Gold press releases dated[April 20, 2026](https://newfoundgold.ca/new-found-gold-announces-205m-finance-package/) and[May 19, 2026](https://newfoundgold.ca/new-found-gold-announces-initial-draw-of-70m-fund-15159/) ).


**Next Steps**


The construction of a permanent on-site crusher and sorter is progressing with anticipated substantial completion in Q4/26 followed by commissioning and ramp up in Q1/27. Once operational, this equipment is expected to reduce crushing costs and allow for delivery of higher-grade material to the Mill.


Diamond drilling of the inferred mineral resource below the current stage one pit at Hammerdown is being completed in preparation for an updated mineral resource estimate in 2027. Grade control drilling is ongoing in the Hammerdown open pit and is currently being modelled for use in refining grade control practices.


As previously announced, the Company plans to convert and expand Pine Cove from the current 700 tpd flotation–leach-Merrill-Crowe circuit to a 1,400 tpd gravity-carbon-in-leach (“ **Gravity-CIL** ”) circuit, with the permit amendment to convert the circuit to Gravity-CIL received and the permit to expand to 1,400 tpd to be applied for in due course (see New Found Gold press release dated[July 6, 2026](https://newfoundgold.ca/new-found-gold-provides-queensway-and-pine-cove-up-15322/) ). The circuit conversion is progressing on schedule and on budget with an anticipated completion in Q4/27.


With commercial production declared at Hammerdown, the Company anticipates a life of mine run rate of 20,000 to 25,000 oz Au produced per year at an AISC2 of approximately US$2,500/oz Au. The Company plans to provide annual guidance for Hammerdown in due course.

**About New Found Gold**


New Found Gold is a new Canadian gold producer with assets in Newfoundland and Labrador, Canada. The Company holds a 100% interest in its flagship asset, the Queensway Gold Project ( **“Queensway”** ), as well as Hammerdown. With commercial production declared at Hammerdown, the Company remains focused on advancing the fully funded Phase 1 of its flagship Queensway to production.


The Company’s portfolio is further strengthened by its district-scale land package at Queensway, covering more than 110 km of strike length across two highly prospective faults zones, and a strong shareholder base, including renowned mining investor and cornerstone shareholder, Eric Sprott.


On August 26, 2026, the Company’s shares began trading on the Toronto Stock Exchange under the symbol “NFGC”, to align with its stock symbol on the NYSE American LLC.
